title: The First Tracks
subtitle: The Web Player & Discovery Era
description: The earliest digital footprint begins in July 2013 on desktop and web player. Listening begins with indie rock, synth-pop, and early 2010s anthems.

evidence.label: Key Artists
evidence.value: The Mowgli's, Calvin Harris, Lana Del Rey, Empire of the Sun

whyThisMatters.observed: Listening took place almost exclusively through web browsers and desktop clients.
whyThisMatters.connected: No mobile or financial records existed in this archive during this timeframe.
whyThisMatters.story: The initial archival footprint is personal and focused purely on digital music discovery.

title: The Commute & The Routine
subtitle: Household Rhythms and Mobile Transition
description: A rich convergence of daily life: Android mobile listening emerges alongside meticulous records of train commutes, chai, snacks, stationery, and Netflix subscriptions.

evidence.label: Top Routines
evidence.value: Train transit (Place 5 to 0), Grocery, Netflix monthly renewal

evidence.label: Mobile Audio
evidence.value: Android becomes the primary streaming device

whyThisMatters.observed: Train commutes and food expenses occur consistently on the same calendar days as mobile music sessions.
whyThisMatters.connected: Music accompaniment transitions from stationary desktop to on-the-move Android listening.
whyThisMatters.story: The archive captures the rhythm of daily urban life, student/work commutes, and morning routines.

title: The Soundtrack
subtitle: Deep Album Marathons and Night Rhythms
description: Listening density surges. Entire discographies of The Beatles, The Strokes, and Coldplay are played in extended nighttime sessions.

evidence.label: Top Discography
evidence.value: The Beatles, The Strokes, Josh Krajcik

whyThisMatters.observed: Extended multi-hour listening sessions with sequential album tracks.
whyThisMatters.connected: Shuffle mode drops while full albums are played end-to-end.
whyThisMatters.story: Music becomes less of a background filler and more of an intentional evening ritual.

title: The Quiet Months
subtitle: Home Focus and Shifting Cadence
description: Listening patterns consolidate into home-centered clusters. Playlists reflect introspection and evening routines with minimal transit activity.

evidence.label: Key Sounds
evidence.value: The New Abnormal (The Strokes), Ambient & Acoustic

whyThisMatters.observed: Activity shifts away from commute hours into late afternoon and night blocks.
whyThisMatters.story: A quieter period defined by familiar sounds and domestic stability.

title: The Modern Canvas
subtitle: Multi-Facet Lifestyle Convergence
description: The fullest convergence in the archive: card transactions across entertainment, travel, and dining intersect with 2023–2024 streaming history.

evidence.label: Active Cities
evidence.value: Rourkela, Jalna, Bharatpur, Udaipur, and others

whyThisMatters.observed: Card transactions in travel and entertainment overlap with music listening spikes.
whyThisMatters.connected: Receipts from multiple cities coincide with listening on mobile networks.
whyThisMatters.story: The digital life matures into an expansive multi-channel canvas of travel, entertainment, and sound.
